# Render requests for trying plotpoint by hand

Invented data. Paths resolve from this folder, so outputs land in `out/`.
Walkthrough: `docs/guide/try-it.md`.

| File | Mode | Shows |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `v1-line.yaml` | D (planned intent) | A line chart with a highlight and a rule callout, to every target |
| `v3-scatter.yaml` | D | A scatter with per-column outlier handling and a note |
| `v2-number.yaml` | D | A single number: text in documents, a tile on a slide |
| `broken.yaml` | D | Three checks failing at once, on purpose |
| `mode-c.yaml` | C (question only) | For Claude to decide the intent; the script alone refuses it |
